value.title: Reviewer — composed plan139 governance port
value.seat: unbound; canary identity required before review

sections.name: mission
sections.value: Cross-model review of the final composed plan139 implementation. Verify one governance world, one event sequence domain, ownership, destructive atomicity, and legacy serve-or-refuse cutover. PM supplies final revision at dispatch; do not review an intermediate source-ready patch as finished code.

value.text: FIRST use absolute PM worktree paths. Load BOTH pij and builder skills, plus validate-v2 review discipline. Canary first: quote pij whoami and actual OMP footer model/effort. Required model is github-copilot/claude-opus-5 high, not inferred from spawn argv.

Read plan/impl-guide/contracts and full final composed diff against baseline d964233d4cbf45400a6b2fc5f873de48909e7e38. PM will pin the exact final SHA. Code is read-only; findings record only under assets/reviews/.

DISBELIEVE AUTHOR RECEIPTS. Derive what code does from actual sources and inspect raw deterministic output behind every green claim. Do not treat authored/unrun tests, source-ready patches or formatter success as behavioral proof. Request a specific missing execution from PM rather than inventing results.

LEAST CONFIDENT: (1) cancellation-shielded publication and shutdown/follower ordering; (2) SQL pool/sequence coherence through real/fake fixture replacements and role service captures; (3) dispatch/decision side-effect and receipt ordering across cancellation/retry; (4) complete CLI native/shim JSON parity and no legacy fallback for any table entry. Hunt these first.

Mandatory priorities: sole spine SQL insertion + all producers bus-owned; atomic destructive row/event commits and rollback witnesses; current ownership and stale-lease HTTP replay refusal; computed anomaly semantics/relay parity; self-answer no-push versus other-answer real push; failed/unknown process probes never reap; no delivery semantics drift from373/374.

Check the shim guard reads the actual skill CLI-verb table, and that synthetic-table-verb mutation is demonstrated failing. Check archive cannot invalidate compiled fixture paths or refusal ledger references. Roles are asserted metadata, never inferred privilege.

KNOWN OPEN/INTENTIONAL: production/chainglass AC2/AC3/AC7/AC9 receipts belong to prime after deploy; PM is locally proved only. compact/new/reload transport, watchdog/chore/focus/etc unported jobs intentionally refuse. PIJ_TMUX_SOCKET guarded-start feature is deferred; strict private-resource recipe is mandatory for proofs.18.1.11 literally printed no-model and must remain unbound, not guessed as requested Astra. Do not re-report these as implementation findings.

No code edits, commits, builds, formatters, linters or project-wide test suites. PM owns final validation and can execute any targeted experiment you justify. Never flowspace3 daemon, live daemon restart/port7461 fixture, main/global/node_modules/toolchain writes, or pij inbox transport-log reads.

For meaning-shaped questions use flowspace3 search first (client only); verify LSP root before believing empty refs. Report source/proof gaps via harness observe without draining buffers. If parent messages land in internal scouts, relay to Main context.

Return material CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM findings only: location, exact evidence, affected contract/AC, impact, smallest fix; try to disprove each against explicit prime rulings first. No style noise or findings quota. no_material_findings is valid.

Write a ddocs review record under assets/reviews using a supported local schema; validate/build it, then send the path and one-line verdict via pij_send to pij-lonely-ikrie. Judge every AC with honest proof grade; production-dependent rows remain pending rather than fabricated accepted.
The PM is your counterpart: verdict and findings go to the PM; the PM may refute findings with evidence — re-judge refutations on the evidence, not on rank.
You do not fix code, commit, or open PRs. If you find something outside the plan's scope, name it as a note for prime rather than expanding the review.
